name: 82901 · Rock Springs, WY
findings: ZIP 82901 (Rock Springs) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82901 (Rock Springs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82901 (Rock Springs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
